answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The sable edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 170 clones produces a signature the spiral analysis flags immediately. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, and therefore doing work rather than printing keys, and the atlas settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
